methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Although no specific project currently exists, the paper draws on relevant scientific literature and best practices to illustrate how exergy analysis and the ISO 50001 system approach

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Conceptual 'pre-research'/feasibility proposal for district-heating modernization. It invokes ISO 50001/50006 and presents a system energy balance (Eq. 1) and an 'example' ISO 50006 EnPI-normalization/baseline table (Table 1), but does not identify or characterise an EnPI/EnB measurement model: no normalization variable, indicator functional form, or baseline construction/period is specified. EnPI/EnB is mentioned only incidentally/aspirationally.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The pre-research indicates that a green transition in Orlandovtsi is feasible if a comprehensive solution is provided

stage1.notes: BORDERLINE ELIGIBILITY - flag for human blind-first review. Near-even call: paper asserts ISO 50006 EnPI normalization + baseline comparison (Table 1, p7) and gives an energy-balance eq (Eq.1, p4), but no EnPI/EnB model is actually characterised -> read as ineligible (conf 0.6). Sector = district heating/CHP for a residential+institutional urban district (Sofia); NOT on the closed continuous-process list, so level_3b would be false regardless.
